summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a 6-K announcing its purchase and termination of a spodumene offtake agreement previously granted to Waratah Capital Advisors for the Moblan Lithium Project, which is 60%-owned by Elevra. Consideration comprised US$5 million in Elevra ordinary shares (at A$12.20 per share) and US$0.5 million in options exercisable at a 50% premium to the issue price, closings on May 12, 2026. The board recommended the deal, citing enhanced strategic flexibility and economics. The shares rank equally; options are exercisable after 120 days and vest over three years. Watch for potential dilution and execution of the scoping study for NAL expansion.
